public.text: WHO-hosted and local publisher-service access — The draft already provides for federation; the correction makes the WHO option visible and prevents compliance from being judged solely by a particular server's storage model. Evidence: WHO API local deployment (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/ICDAPI-LocalDeployment/).
public.suggestedRevision: Replace bullet: – Federation and alignment with international sources. Governed access to, synchronisation with, or reference to content from WHO and other international terminology authorities. For ICD-11, an implementation may use the WHO-hosted API or an appropriate local deployment, with the release, language, supported functions, availability arrangements, and update process declared. Local proposals shall be routed to the publisher's maintenance process; national deployment shall preserve the international source's identity and meaning.
